main_text.p: ro, bo. At contractum verbum, auget figurativam temporaliter: ut Ἰ-μάω Ἰμήσω, φιλέω φιλήσω, χευσάω χευ-σώσω. Sed anomalia hîc multa est.
In prima specie contractorum, multa retinent figurativam.
1. ε̄άω, ῑάω, ο̄άω: ut ε̄άω fino.
ἀκροάω audio, & cætera similia. Mutant tamen γοάω gemo, ululo, βοάω clamo. Retinent autem & mutant:
ἀλοάω (poëticè ἀλοιάω) tritum, percutio, ἀσω vel ἡσω. sic item
δράω facio, δράσω & δρήσω: unde δυσδρη-σομαι diffugiam, διεδρησάμην diffugi.
2. Trisyllaba in εχω & λεχω præce-dente dente

page.notes: Greek words are printed in a mixed, partly worn state; accents and some letters are uncertain and rendered from the scan without guarantee. Several Greek forms near the line ends are doubtful. The word "dente" closes the page, printed on the last line after "præce-".
